finalCta.paragraph: History: The DV5RC is a 1.5-litre four-cylinder diesel engine introduced by Stellantis (formerly PSA) in 2018. It was designed to replace the older 1.6L DV6 family, offering improved fuel economy, lower CO2 emissions, and smoother operation. In the Peugeot 2008, it was introduced with the Gen 2 (P24) model in 2019, available in 100hp and 130hp variants. The engine features a turbocharger, common-rail direct injection, and a selective catalytic reduction (SCR) system with AdBlue to meet Euro 6d emissions standards.
